title: Seeing at the Edge: Energy Characterization of Vision-Language Model Inference on Edge Platforms
abstract: arXiv:2610.20136v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are moving onto edge devices, but little is known about how much energy they draw on single-board computers with NPU or GPU accelerators, or where that energy goes. We measure total-system energy, latency, and thermal behavior of Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct and its text-only sibling on a Raspberry Pi 5 with a Hailo-10H NPU and on a Jetson Orin Nano Super, on both CPU and accelerator, and separate the fixed energy of each request from the energy that grows with output length. Because the accelerators use different quantization and serving software, we compare deployment stacks rather than silicon. Three findings stand out. First, NPU offloading makes the Pi a much more efficient VLM platform: it cuts energy per generated token by about two-thirds, leaves the host CPU largely free, and avoids the thermal throttling that the CPU backend reaches in sustained use. translated_title: 边缘视觉：边缘平台上视觉语言模型推理的能耗特性分析
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）正在向边缘设备迁移，但人们对其在配备NPU或GPU加速器的单板计算机上究竟消耗多少能量、以及这些能量去向何处，仍然知之甚少。我们在配备Hailo-10H NPU的树莓派5和Jetson Orin Nano Super上，分别在CPU和加速器上运行Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct及其纯文本对应模型，测量了整机能耗、延迟和热行为，并将每次请求的固定能耗与随输出长度增长的能耗分离开来。由于这些加速器使用不同的量化和推理服务软件，我们比较的是部署软件栈而非芯片硬件本身。研究有三个突出发现。第一，NPU卸载使树莓派成为一个高效得多的VLM平台：它将每个生成token的能耗降低约三分之二，让主机CPU基本保持空闲，并避免了CPU后端在持续运行中出现的 thermal throttling（热节流）。第二，图像输入会同时增加固定能耗和每token能耗……
tldr: 该论文首次系统测量了视觉语言模型在树莓派5和Jetson等边缘平台上的能耗特性，发现NPU卸载可将每token能耗降低约三分之二、避免热节流，并揭示图像输入会同时带来固定能耗和随输出长度增长的额外能耗。
